title: linnaea serpyllifolia
intro: Linnaea serpyllifolia, commonly known as Twinflower, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Primulaceae. It is native to North America and is known for its twining stems and small, white, bell-shaped flowers. The health benefits of Twinflower include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Linnaea serpyllifolia include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
